visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark wavy hair, wearing a blue denim cap and a light beige cropped zip-up hoodie, stands in front of a brightly lit yellow shopfront featuring digital menus. She holds a paper cup containing a large golden-brown bubble waffle topped with white cream and nuts. She uses a small wooden stick to take a bite, widening her eyes in an expression of pleasant surprise. (2) The camera zooms in for a medium close-up on her face as she chews. She looks directly into the lens, nodding slightly while maintaining a joyful smile. The background to the left shows a dimly lit street with a closed metal shutter. (3) The woman begins to speak animatedly, gesturing with her free hand. She takes another small piece of the topping with the wooden stick. The lighting is bright and warm, primarily sourced from the storefront. (4) She steps back from the shop entrance, turning her body slightly. She continues talking with high energy, her facial expressions shifting rapidly as she reacts to the food. A passer-by is briefly visible in the distant background.
